title: cwc-chicago-1998-chicago-championship
label: Andrew "Flash" Tucker

won.source: Won the eight-man Chicago Championship tournament final at In Your Face: Judgment Day, pinning-- submitting Jack Vars with a figure-four leglock after Outcast by Society clipped Vars' knee with a steel chair at ringside.

note: The fed's first-ever Chicago Heavyweight Champion; no further title document survives in the held record.

title: cwc-chicago-1998-cook-county-championship
label: "Flatlander" Duke Putrid

won.source: Won the eight-man Cook County Championship tournament final, a ladder match against Tommy Grayson, at In Your Face: Judgment Day, by retrieving the title belt.

note: The fed's first-ever Cook County Champion; no further title document survives in the held record.
